tips.text: Build Wyrm for Negate; the base frame works the same as Wyrm Prime for it.
Buy Manifold Bond from Master Teasonai (Ostron Rank 3 Trusted, 20,000 standing) to shorten Negate's cooldown.
Don't treat Negate as a Primed Sure Footed replacement; it blocks one status, and one you already resist still spends the charge.
Expect Negate to stop working while Wyrm is inactive, such as during Titania's Razorwing.
Put Negate in the bottom-right precept slot; it can stop later precepts from firing.
Start scanning for Simaris standing while the 24-hour build runs.
Ask a friend for Negate if you can; it is tradeable.
